label: PLACEHOLDER written by Team Sunvai: common remedial reading activities, to be replaced by activities retrieved from the NCERT Class 1-2 teacher handbook. Not NCERT text.

activities.title: Letter cards
activities.steps: Show one letter card at a time; the group names it together, then each child names one card. Mix in letters the group confuses.

activities.title: Matra ladder
activities.steps: Write one letter (क) with each vowel sign in a column (का कि की कु कू के कै को कौ). Read down the ladder together, then each child reads one rung.

activities.title: Slide the sounds
activities.steps: Say the sounds of a short word slowly, sliding a finger under each letter, then faster until they join into the word (क-म-ल, कमल). Children copy with their own finger.

activities.title: Build the word
activities.steps: Give a group letter and matra cards. Say a word from today's page; the group builds it, then reads it aloud.

activities.title: Echo reading
activities.steps: Read one line from the page with your finger under the words; the group reads it back. Then one child leads the next line.

activities.title: Picture and word
activities.steps: Put picture cards and word cards on the floor. Children match each word to its picture and read it aloud.
